about.text: 📚 Smart Library Telegram Bot An intelligent online digital library bot designed to search and discover books, university & school textbooks, and educational materials across virtually any topic. ✨ Features: • 📚 Search books by title, author, and keywords • 🎓 Search textbooks across academic subjects and disciplines • 📂 Categorized browsing by genres and topics • 🔥 Discover popular, trending, and highly read books • ⭐ Save books to Favorites for instant access • 📄 Rich metadata: authors, publication year, publisher, ISBN, and summary • 🔗 Direct legal sources for online reading and purchasing 🌐 Integrated Sources: • Google Books API — global literature database, previews, and official store links • Open Library (Internet Archive) — millions of digitized books with open access • Project Gutenberg & Internet Archive — public domain classics and direct downloads ⚖️ Copyright Compliance: This bot strictly respects copyright laws. All materials link directly to legal sources, open licenses (Public Domain, Creative Commons), or official publisher/reading pages.
